description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Academy Duffel sports bag offers ample space to transport all your training or match equipment. Its resistant design incorporates specific compartments to keep the material organized and several transport options to comfortably take it anywhere.
key_benefits: Large main compartment: Enough space for clothes, ball and sports equipment.
Handles and adjustable strap: Allow it to be carried comfortably on the shoulder or in the hand.
Zippered pockets: Perfect for storing personal items in an organized way.
Official shield of FC Barcelona: Ideal design for fans of the club.
